acceptanceCriteria: A compaction in which the host summary or rehydration packet keeps the pin line reports pin preserved.
A compaction that drops the pin still reports compaction-pin-not-preserved.
A test reproduces the 2026-10-19 false report from a recorded host payload.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: The PostCompact pin verifier reports compaction-pin-not-preserved after nearly every compaction, although the SessionStart(source=compact) packet carries the pin line verbatim and the summary is host-authored. Either the verifier looks in the wrong place (summary text vs rehydration packet), or the pin is not emitted where the host preserves it. Determine which, fix it, and keep a real loss reported. Evidence: `corvint observations` in ~/projects/corvint on 2026-10-19 (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 668, Claude Code plugin corvint@corvint 0.3.1).
title: Claude Code post-compact reports compaction-pin-not-preserved in 59 hour windows (latest 2026-10-19T12Z)
